description:
[b]Official presets can only publish Edwfur, if someone puts out presets marked as CWAV, please inform me on Steam or Discord.[/b]

[h1]Update 2.0: Media Integration[/h1]

[h2]What's New[/h2]

- [b]Removed Spotify Sync Module:[/b] Due to unavailability in Russia (where development is based), the Spotify synchronization module has been removed.

- [b]Added Media Integration Module:[/b]
  - [b]Features:[/b]
    - [b]Display Current Track Information:[/b] The new media integration module allows users to view information about the currently playing track, including the album cover, title, artist, and duration.
[img] https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/446685594895122442/1178469097030303964/image.png?ex=657641df&is=6563ccdf&hm=0342077fa89042aa7aea9058c844776bb80dafa62cbebe8908504cb208079525& [/img]
[img] https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/446685594895122442/1178469224587477185/image.png?ex=657641fe&is=6563ccfe&hm=6dc1c04f3993b51a952359008605b452b299195fd1561726f7ba586a6a25f901&=&format=webp&width=667&height=203 [/img]
[img] https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/446685594895122442/1178469614628376576/image.png?ex=6576425b&is=6563cd5b&hm=f5f9e0db84c657b7195dd77fe5d1513b8195c04c7e52eb7507b7d95f047cf22f&=&format=webp&width=788&height=200 [/img]
  
    - [b]Seamless Settings Integration:[/b] The settings for the media integration module mirror those of the Spotify module, providing a familiar and user-friendly experience.

  [h2]How to Use[/h2]
    1. [b]Navigate to the CWAV settings.[/b]
    2. [b]Find the "Media Integration" section.[/b]
    3. [b]Enable the module[/b] to start enjoying enhanced track information while using the app.

[b]Enjoy the upgraded media experience with our latest update![/b]

Thank you for using [b]CWAV[/b]! If you have any feedback or encounter issues, please let us know at discord. You can always offer your improvements to us and we will certainly listen to you.

[b]Note:[/b] If you wish for CWAV to continue receiving updates, please let us know your feedback.

en-us.ui_background_mode_video_text: <small>★Video must be in the WebM format.</small>
en-us.ui_color__highContrastColor: High Contrast color <small>Black or white, depending on what has higher contrast with the primary color.</small>
en-us.ui_color__textColor: Text color <small>Guaranteed to have sufficient contrast with primary color.</small>
en-us.ui_reactor_text: <small>This functionality is in the Alpha Closed Test. For more details, see steam, discord.</small>
en-us.ui_time_date_text:
★You can change date format manually
{DD} {MM} {YYYY}
{week} {wek} {month} {,}
For example:{month} {DD}
Результат: September 20
en-us.ui_weather_format_text:
★You can change weather format manually
{city} {temp} {feels} {,}
{pressure} {wind} {winddir} {uv_index}
{weather} {precip} {humidity} {visibility}
For example: {temp}℃, feels {feels}℃ and now {weather}
Result: 26℃, feels 24℃ and now Cloudy

ru-ru.ui_color__highContrastColor: Высокий контраст <small>Черный или белый, в зависимости от того, что имеет больший контраст с основным цветом.</small>
ru-ru.ui_color__textColor: Цвет текста <small>Гарантируется достаточный контраст с основным цветом.</small>
ru-ru.ui_reactor_text: <small>Данный функцианал находиться в Alpha Closed Test. Более подробно вы можете ознакомится в steam, discord.</small>
ru-ru.ui_weather_city_text: <small>★Город(zip-cod, ip, cordin) должен быть на англ. например: Moscow</small>
ru-ru.ui_weather_format_text:
★Формат погоды можно прописать вручную
{city} {temp} {feels} {,}
{pressure} {wind} {winddir} {uv_index}
{weather} {precip} {humidity} {visibility}
Например: {temp}℃, по ощущениям {feels}℃ и сейчас {weather}
Результат: 26℃, по ощущениям 24℃ и сейчас Cloudy

uk-ua.ui_color__highContrastColor: Високий контраст <small>Чорний або білий, залежно від того, що має більший контраст з основним кольором.</small>
uk-ua.ui_color__textColor: Колір тексту <small>Гарантується достатній контраст з основним кольором.</small>
uk-ua.ui_weather_city_text: <small>★Місто(zip-cod, ip, cordin) повинно бути англ. Наприклад: Poltava</small>

★Формат погоди можна налаштувати самостійно
{city} {temp} {feels} {,}
{pressure} {wind} {winddir} {uv_index}
{weather} {precip} {humidity} {visibility}
Наприклад: {temp}℃, відчувається як {feels}℃ і зараз {weather}
Результат: 26℃, відчувається як 24℃ і зараз Cloudy
